description: Composite figure of five texture-fibre intensity plots from Fig. 9 (panels (b)–(f)) for cold-rolled Fe–30Mn–11Al–1.2C low-density steel; the companion α-fiber panel (a) is not present in the supplied image set. (b) τ-fiber (<110>//TD, φ1=90°, φ2=45°): f(g) vs Φ (0–90°, ticks every 15°), 0–8 scale; the 50% green curve peaks between the 6 and 7 gridlines at Φ≈33°, a red arrow points toward higher Φ and a blue arrow marks a weak CuT component near Φ≈60–70°. (c) γ-fiber (<111>//ND, Φ=55°, φ2=45°), f(g) only 0–2.0 vs φ1 (0–90°): 90% red starts just below 2.0, 50% green stays near zero until φ1≈35°. (d) β-fiber, f(g) 0–8 vs φ2 = 45–90° with cropped Miller-index headers; the 70% magenta curve peaks near the 6.0 gridline around φ2≈70° and the 90% red curve rises above 7.0 near 85–90°. (e) Φ (0–90°) of the maximum-intensity position vs φ2; (f) φ1 (0–90°) vs φ2, all five curves falling monotonically overall from ~75–90° to ~20–50°. Shared colour legend (shown in c): 10% black squares, 30% dark-blue circles, 50% green up-triangles, 70% magenta down-triangles, 90% red diamonds = cold rolling reduction. Together the panels show a continuous B→Goss shift of the β-fibre maximum and a Cu intensity that rises to a 50% maximum before falling.

subfigures.description: τ-fiber plot: f(g) (0–8) versus Φ [°] (0–90°), annotated 'τ-fiber', '<110>//TD', 'φ1=90°', 'φ2=45°'. The green (50%) curve gives the highest intensity with a peak near Φ≈33°, red squares/diamonds also peak near Φ≈45°; a red arrow runs down-right marking a shift toward higher Φ and a blue arrow near Φ≈60–70° marks the weak CuT region.

γ-fiber plot: f(g) (0–2.0, much smaller scale than the other panels) versus φ1 [°] (0–90°), annotated 'γ-fiber', '<111>//ND', 'Φ=55°', 'φ2=45°'. Contains the only colour legend: 10% black squares, 30% dark-blue circles, 50% green triangles, 70% magenta down-triangles, 90% red diamonds. The 90% red curve is the strongest (starts just below 2.0 at φ1=0°, dips to a minimum near φ1=15°, then plateaus ~1.0–1.1 with a dip near 75°); the 50% green curve is essentially zero until φ1≈35°.

β-fiber plot: f(g) (0–8) versus φ2 [°] (45–90°, ticks every 5°); top-axis Miller-index annotations are cropped/partially readable. The 70% magenta curve rises to a peak near the 6.0 gridline at φ2≈70° then falls sharply to a minimum near 75°; the 90% red curve falls to a minimum near 75° and then climbs above the 7.0 gridline at 85–90°; the 10% black curve stays low (≈0.5–2).

Plot of the Φ Euler angle (0–90°) of the maximum-intensity position along the β-fibre versus φ2 [°] (45–90°), five unlabelled coloured curves. The black curve starts near Φ≈20° at φ2=45°, rises to ~55° around 60–65°, dips near 75° and rises again to ~55° at 80°; the red curve starts highest (~65° at 45°) and declines to ~45°; the blue curve dips to ~22–25° around φ2=50–55° then rises to ~50° at 90°.

Plot of the φ1 Euler angle (0–90°) of the maximum-intensity position versus φ2 [°] (45–90°). All curves decrease overall: the red curve falls steeply from ~85° at φ2=45° to ~20° at 90°, the blue from ~90° to ~40°, magenta from ~85° to ~35°, green from ~85° to ~45°, and black stays the flattest, oscillating between ~50° and ~75°.

observations.observation: Panel (c) carries the figure's only legend, mapping cold rolling reduction to marker/colour: 10% black squares, 30% dark-blue circles, 50% green up-triangles, 70% magenta down-triangles, 90% red diamonds.
Panel (b) is annotated 'τ-fiber', '<110>//TD', with fixed angles 'φ1=90°' and 'φ2=45°', and its abscissa is Φ [°] spanning 0–90°.
In panel (b) the maximum f(g) of the panel is reached by the 50% green curve, peaking between the 6 and 7 gridlines of the f(g) axis at Φ close to 33–35°.
A red arrow in panel (b) points toward higher Φ, and a separate blue arrow near Φ≈60–70° marks a low-intensity feature (identified by the text as the CuT component).
Panel (c) is labelled 'γ-fiber', '<111>//ND', 'Φ=55°', 'φ2=45°' and its f(g) axis spans only 0–2.0, roughly one quarter of the 0–8 range used in panels (b) and (d).
In panel (c) the 90% red curve begins just below the 2.0 tick at φ1=0°, falls to a minimum near φ1=15°, and then oscillates around 1.0–1.1, while the 50% green curve remains near zero until φ1≈35°.
Panel (d) plots the β-fibre with f(g) on a 0–8 axis against φ2 [°] from 45° to 90°; the top-axis Miller-index annotations are cropped and only partially readable.
In panel (d) the 70% magenta curve peaks close to the 6.0 gridline around φ2≈70° and then drops sharply, whereas the 90% red curve passes above the 7.0 gridline at φ2 = 85–90°.
Panels (e) and (f) plot the Euler angles Φ and φ1 of the maximum-intensity position along the β-fibre against φ2 (45–90°), using the same five colours as the fibre panels.
All five curves in panel (f) decrease overall with increasing φ2, the red curve falling most steeply from about the 85° level at φ2 = 45° to about 20° at φ2 = 90°.

The caption states that the maximum-intensity position along the β-fibre shifts continuously from B towards Goss as cold rolling reduction increases, which is what panels (e) and (f) are said to show.
The citing text states that the Cu orientation intensity increased rapidly to a maximum at 50% rolling reduction and then decreased, with Ф shifting to higher values (red arrow in Fig. 9(b)).
The citing text states that the γ-fiber remained weak at all rolling reductions and was slightly strengthened at 90% reduction, most noticeably at the {111}<110> E position.

The citing text states that the α-fiber panel (a) shows {110}<112> Brass increasing and scattering toward {110}<100> Goss, with the maximum shifting from Ψ1 = 45° to 20° above 50% reduction; this α-fiber panel is not present in the supplied images.
The citing text interprets the Cu and CuT shifts of Fig. 9(b) as consistent with latent hardening and the slight γ-fiber strengthening of Fig. 9(c) as indirect evidence of deformation twinning.
